description.name: Entry
description.text:
Grants Tactical Awoken Mode, MAG +500, MND +500 to user, grants [Quick ATB 1] to user & Clive if Clive is in party
Tactical Awoken Mode: Fire Ability Boost, Triplecast Fire, Unlimited Fire Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Fire Abilities, Fire Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Fire Abilities; Ends after using 8 Fire abilities
TP Max: AOE Fire/NE hybrid attack at True Cap Break Level 1

description.name: War-Awoken Will to Protect (Weapon Skill)
description.text:
One single piercing hybrid attack at True Cap Break Level 1, grants [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Fire Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if the user has at least Lv.0/2 [Attach Fire]
WS Blue: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking] to user
WS Gold: Grants [Fire Ability Damage +30% for 5 turns & Quick Fire 5] to party
